description: This file defines the AiProvider interface and related functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, as well as a type guard function to check object conformity.

methods.name: instanceOfAiProvider
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements the AiProvider interface.

methods.name: AiProviderFromJSON
methods.description: Converts a JSON object to an AiProvider instance.

methods.name: AiProviderFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Converts a JSON object to an AiProvider instance with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: AiProviderToJSON
methods.description: Serializes an AiProvider object to JSON.
